book.name: iMatiu
book.title: Esɔ Osuse mi abɔ mgbi iMatiu

content: IYesu ngyɛlu inggisɛ nkwuluafɔ yi abɔ ootse
IYesu kaka uwaa, foye luba igeli mgban.
Engyulɔ angbeka kye inggisɛ nkwulu afɔ yi abɔ ba mbon, ladzɛ amukwu. Ngwi iYesu di oyɛyɛ onuunu mgbi ama nɛ, o nya inggisɛ otummya na gbɛɛ, <<Ka teeyi ba, ongwani; a dzita abu yi ali ibwubwe.>>
Mi ungwɔnɛ nɛ, etsetse mgbi ola mgbi iMose angbeka gbɔ yi ewoma gbɛɛ, <<Inggisɛ nɛ le fya Imgbasho ito!>>
Ngwi iYesu ye ewodzɛ mgbi ama nɛ, o gbɛɛ, <<Kyɔsinɛ ngwi ema le tsɛwodzɛ ibwubwe mi itukwu nghaa?
Li ole nghao sunɔ ba: li ogbɛɛ, <A dzita abu yi ali ibwubwe,> naadi ogbɛɛ, <Kyato kyikyɛ>?
Kpaa li ikye ni ema ye gbɛɛ Ongwɛ Inggisɛ dzɛ yi mfye mi ɛsɛ nɛ odzɛ inggisɛ ta yi ali ibwubwe...>> Ta o nya inggisɛ ntummya ma gbɛɛ, <<Kyato, kye amukwu mgbi abu lu udɛ.>>
Ongyulɔ ma si kyato lu udɛ.
Ngwi ibyi inggisɛ ntona di ungwɔnɛ nɛ, imio wo ma; man a si tsɛ Imgbasho, ongwu nkye itɔ mfye na nu inggisɛ mani.
Ela okwu-kwu mgbi iMatiu
Dafi iYesu dzata imbe na kiyayi nɛ, o di ongyulɔ ngwu a li kwun gbɛɛ iMatiu sɔdzɛ imbe mgbi ama ogbɛ udza ifyɛɛ. O nyan gbɛɛ <<Kyɛdɔ ani,>> ta iMatiu si kyato kyɛdɔn.
Ngwi iYesu le gye oga ongwi onɔdɛ mi udɛ iMatiu nɛ, ama ogbɛ udza ifyɛɛ gwuba yi <<emi ali ibwubwe>> ba wa gye ungwogye yan bɛyi engwafɔɔn.
Ngwi emi iFarasi di ungwɔnɛ nɛ, a byi engwafɔɔn gbɛɛ, <<Kyɔsinɛse otsetse mgbi ema le gye ungwogye yi ama ogbɛ udza ifyɛɛ bɛyi <emi ali ibwubwe>? >>
Ngwi iYesu fwo odzɛ nɛ nɛ, o gbɛɛ, <<Inggisɛ ama nle saan mina inggisɛ obwe ootse ba, kpaa li ama ndotse ta.
Nghaduu lu na ka kpayi ungwɔ ngwi odzɛ nɛ tso mani: <Ani mina elela odiidi, yama li ifɛ ofɛ-fɛ ba.> Ikyesinɛ ani ba owa kwu ama osaan ela ba, kpaa li emi ali ibwubwe.>>
A byi iYesu ita mi odzɛondu otukwu-tukwu
Nɛ engwafɔ iJɔn ba wa byi iYesu gbɛɛ, <<Kyɔsinɛ ngwi eyi yi emi iFarasi li tukwondu, kpaa engwafɔ abu li tukwondu ba?>>
IYesu nu uka gbɛɛ, <<Ka kyɔsinɛ ngwi ingyoga mgbi obongyaa ofufɛ ka kyelela ngwi o ka dzɛ yi ama? Onɔ ka wa ba ngwi a ka kyi kyelu obongyaa ofufɛ mboma; ta a ka tukwondu.
<<Inggisɛ onyi kpaa li kye ayɛ angwuto ofufɛ tukwu ishangli ba. Ikyesinɛ otukwu-tukwu na ka kwɔdzɛ vɔn.

Naadi inggisɛ li kye eneekwɔ ofufɛ yaokɛ ikpɔkpɔ eneekwɔ ogbugbe kpaa ba. Kini otsungwɔ kyɔ ngha, ikpɔkpɔ na ka gbobu, eneekwɔ na ka yangwuta man ikpɔkpɔ na ka nyanya. Ei, a li kye eneekwɔ ofufɛ yaokɛ ikpɔkpɔ ofufɛ man ama duu ka nyanya ba.>>
Ongwongyaa ikwukwɔ bɛyi ongyaandotse
Dafi iYesu le gbɔdzɛ nɛ, ongye ogbe inggisɛ teyi ba wa gbe akwafɔ kwɛsɛ mi iyayi mbon si gbɛɛ, <<Ongwani ongwu ongyaa kuma kwulu ta aani. Nghaduu ba wa kye abɔ mgbi abu gbon, ta o ka dzɛ oshishe.>>
IYesu si kyato yi engwafɔɔn kɛ yan.
Mi onɔ mata ongyaa nle yɛ eyi mɛ onova iwyodefa ba mi iyikpa mgbi iYesu wa kye abɔ gbon ondu angwuto.
O gbɔ yi ewon gbɛɛ, <<Ni ani kye abɔ gbon gbo-gbo angwuto kpata, ootse mgbi ani ka ngyɛ.>>
IYesu kyata din, si gbɛɛ, <<Fyumfye itukwu, ongwani; oyɛyɛ onuunu mgbi abu ngyɛlu abu ootse.>> Man ootse mgbi ongyaa na si ngyɛ mi onɔ nani.
Ngwi iYesu kaka udɛ ongye ogbe inggisɛ teyi wa di ama ofo elete yi ibyi inggisɛ tole wulu nɛ,
o gbɛɛ, <<Lu enggengga na, ongwongyaa nɛ kwulu ba kpaa o le nanuna.>> A si shan isha.
Ngwi a nu ibyi inggisɛ ntona tasɛ nɛ, iYesu kaka ifoozu ka byi ongwongyaa na mi abɔ, man o kyato.
Odzɛ nɛ si gbɔfwɛ kpatsɛ ayɛsɛ na duu.
IYesu kwulu obinɛ efa inɛ
Dafi iYesu dzata imbe na le lu nɛ, obinɛ nghi efa kyɛdɔn, le kweela gbɛɛ, <<Di eyi elela, Ongwɛ iDevedi!>>
Ngwi o yɛ lu onufozu nɛ, obinɛ ntona si ba mbon, man o byi ma gbɛɛ, <<Ema noyɛyɛ gbɛɛ ani ka yagba kwulu ema inɛɛ?>> A gbɛɛ, <<Ɛɛn, Otsɛ.>>
Nɛ o kye abɔ gbo ma inɛ si gbɛɛ, <<No kyɔ dafi oyɛyɛ onuunu mgbi ema dzɛ mani>>
ta inɛ mgbi ama kwulu. IYesu kwo ma adɔ kpɔklɔɔ gbɛɛ, <<Di gbɛɛ ema nu inggisɛ onyi ye odzɛ mi ungwɔnɛ ba na.>>
Nghaduu a tasɛ ka kye odzɛ mgban gbɔ kpatsɛ ɛsɛ na duu.
Ngwi iYesu yi engwafɔɔn le tasɛ nɛ, a kye inggisɛ ngwu onodzi ibwubwe bwan non yɛɛ ikplima ba mbon.
IYesu lɔ onodzi emɛsɛ na onya tɔ ta, inggisɛ ikplima na si gbɔdzɛ. I kwulu ibyi inggisɛ ntona ewo ta a gbɛɛ, <<Nkonyonyi itɔ nɛ kpaa kyɔ mi ɛsɛ Israi ye waba.>>
Nghaduu emi iFarasi gbɛɛ, <<Li ongyukwo mgbi emɛsɛ nun mfye se ngwi o le dulu onodzi emɛsɛ tɔ aali.>>
Elela kyɔ iYesu wo inggisɛ ntonani
IYesu kaka igeli yi agwudɛ duu le tsungwɔ mi ozu okwakye mgbi emi iJuda, le gbɔ Esɔ Osuse mgbi esutɔ dile ngyɛlu ali ootse yi ama ngwu i sisi loma ewo duu.
Ngwi o di ibyi inggisɛ nɛ, elela kyɔn wo ma, ikyekyɛ a dzɛ yi okakewo di yɛɛ elela, inggisɛ ogbe ma teyi dzɛma ba, dafi mmala ndzɛ yi inggisɛ ongyo ma ba mani.
Ta iYesu nya engwafɔɔn gbɛɛ, <<Etɔ oshɛ-shɛ le gwuba, kpaa emi idɔ le gwee ta.
Bɔ Otsɛ mgbi etɔ oshɛ-shɛ no gbe emi idɔ ba okwɔ mgban.>>
